title: Matrix 1-Norm
source_docs: DSP System Toolbox/Math Functions/Matrices and Linear Algebra/Matrix Operations/Matrix_1_Norm.md
text: Compute 1-norm of matrix, 1 input, 1 output, no direct feedthrough, {Rounding mode} sets Method of rounding operation; {Saturate on integer overflow} sets the overflow handling method, {Accumulator}, {Output}, {Output Minimum} sets the minimum value that block can output, {Output Maximum} sets the maximum value that block can output and {Lock data type settings against changes by the fixed-point tools} prevents fixed-point tools from overriding data. Values come from the instance.

params.name: Rounding mode
params.values: Method of rounding operation Floor (default) | Ceiling | Convergent | Nearest | Round | Simplest | Zero

params.name: Accumulator
params.values: Accumulator data type Inherit: Inherit via internal rule (default) | Inherit: Same as input | fixdt([],16,0)

params.name: Output
params.values: Output data type Inherit: Same as accumulator (default) | Inherit: Same as input | fixdt([],16,0)

params.name: Output Minimum
params.values: Minimum value that block can output [] (default) | scalar

params.name: Output Maximum
params.values: Maximum value that block can output [] (default) | scalar

params.name: Lock data type settings against changes by the fixed-point tools
params.values: Prevent fixed-point tools from overriding data types off (default) | on
